settings.heading: Read the complete panel
settings.text: Start with what is present, how much is present, and why it is there.

settings.heading: Check the product purpose
settings.text: Everyday, Energy, and Creatine solve different jobs. The page should make that distinction obvious.

settings.heading: Verify the proof
settings.text: Testing, reviews, guarantees, and comparisons should appear only when they can be substantiated.

settings.heading: Transparency should be part of the product.
settings.body: Clean design cannot make a weak label trustworthy. The formula, quantities, testing information, and purchase terms need to do that work.

settings.heading: Read the label before the reviews.
settings.body: Then choose the product whose purpose and ingredients match your routine.
settings.note: No invented proof. No hidden blend totals.
